entry.content:
Starlette: Unvalidated request path concatenated into authority poisons request.url.hostname

Aliases: CVE-2026-54282, PYSEC-2026-248

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N

Affected:

  • starlette — fixed in 1.3.0

### Summary In affected versions, the HTTP request path is not validated before being used to reconstruct `request.url`.
